security_spec.violation_condition: QEMU makes mip.STIP read-only when stimecmp exists (ext_sstc) without also requiring menvcfg.STCE=1, causing STIP to be unwritable by M-mode when STCE=0 — violating the spec that STIP is only read-only when both stimecmp is implemented AND STCE=1
security_spec.vulnerability_pattern: STIP writability gated on ext_sstc/stimecmp presence alone, without a dynamic check of menvcfg.STCE; also applies to mvip.STIP alias, sip.STIP visibility, and any static/init-time STCE evaluation that fails to re-evaluate on menvcfg write
security_spec.summary: When stimecmp is implemented but STCE=0, M-mode must still write STIP to inject timer interrupts to S-mode; read-only gating requires both stimecmp presence AND active STCE
